page.layout: One page of text, one column, starting from the top: running head "PRÆFATIO." centred above the text; then the continuing paragraph; then two centred lines of verse below it. No margin notes, no page number, no catchword.

p.i: pem tenere locum, qui meliora docentes a-mant, & honorant & sequuntur. Hæc ante rem, & quidem, opinor, non ab re, mihi in hac Aculeonum & in alienis rebus hoc ævi Curionum ubertate, qui infscitiæ suæ hostoriæ, vel eruditione stipatissimâ rodere audent obvia quæq[?], monendus fuisti,

page.notes: The first word "pem" is a fragment: the initial letter is cut off at the page start, so it is printed as seen. "a-mant" keeps the printed line-end hyphen. "quaeq;" has a superscript abbreviation mark, read here as quæq; with [?]. "infscitiæ" is read as printed and is uncertain. The flourish after "docte" in the last line is not transcribed.
